headline: Flood Alert for Test River Station
instruction: Critical water level 12.50m detected at Test River Station. Exceeds safety mark by 4.50m. Move to designated high ground immediately!
description: Hydrodynamic prediction simulation breach at Test River Station. Forecast surge cresting in 0.0 hours.
short_text: FLOOD ALERT: Test River Station - Hydrodynamic prediction simulation breach at Test. Critical water level 12.50m detected at Test River. [16:26 IST]
